obj.location: inside strip_prefix, in the return used when s starts with p
obj.cause: The slice skips one extra character after the prefix because it uses len(p) + 1, so 'foobar' becomes 'ar' instead of 'bar'.
obj.change: Start the slice at len(p), not len(p) + 1.
obj.verification: The failing case would then slice 'foobar' from index 3, producing 'bar'.
